input.sparql:
PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref#>
SELECT ?zoneUri ?zoneLabel ?pt ?tsid WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:Room .
  OPTIONAL { ?zone rdfs:label ?zoneLabel }
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?pt .
  ?pt brick:isPointOf ?zone .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(str(?pt), "Air_Temperature_Sensor"))
  ?pt ref:hasExternalReference ?ref .
  ?ref ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
}
LIMIT 200
